name: Ideation & Discovery
description: Explore problems, research markets and users, and validate ideas before committing resources.

name: Requirements & Design
description: Turn validated ideas into specs, designs, and plans engineering can build against.

name: Build
description: Write, generate, and assemble the product itself — code, content, campaigns, or models.

name: Test & QA
description: Verify quality, find regressions, and confirm the work is ready to ship.

name: Release & Operate
description: Ship, deploy, monitor, and keep systems running reliably in production.

name: Go-to-Market & Sales
description: Launch, sell, and communicate the value of what was built to the market.

name: Support & Maintenance
description: Support customers, fix issues, and keep the product healthy after launch — feeding learnings back into the next round of ideation.
